title: Cart total with promotion exclusions and a shipping threshold
prompt:
Here's my cart:
- 1 x LIP-008-02 (Aurevia Glass Lip Color, Sunset)
- 1 x BLS-009-01 (Aurevia Daily Blush)
- 1 x CNC-001-101C (Aurevia Bright Concealer)

With the Aurevia Week promotion, how much will I pay in total, including shipping?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"merchandise_subtotal": number, "discount_total": number, "shipping": number, "order_total": number}. merchandise_subtotal is the sum of unit price x quantity before any discount; discount_total is the total promotion discount; shipping is the shipping fee; order_total = merchandise_subtotal - discount_total + shipping. Use dollars with two decimals.
why_hard: All three items are Aurevia, which invites a blanket 20% discount, but the blush is both a new launch and final sale, so it is excluded. The cart is $55.00 before discounts and $47.60 after, so the free-shipping threshold flips depending on whether it is applied before or after the discount.
traps: Discounting the excluded Aurevia blush (is_new and final_sale)
Applying the free-shipping threshold to the pre-discount subtotal
